phases.objective: Provide a workflow-dispatch-only live verifier that binds Production DNS, TLS, HTTP, service identity, branch identity, and deployed commit identity to one exact reviewed SHA without credentials or runtime mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Production Runtime Parity Evidence pull-request contract job
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Synthetic DNS, TLS, HTTP, and runtime-identity regressions plus workflow-contract assertions prove the verifier rejects unsafe endpoints and mismatched runtime identity, persists only bounded secret-free evidence, and reserves real network probing for an explicit workflow_dispatch after the tooling is merged to trusted main.
steps: Load the reporter and validate exact Production SHA, branch, endpoint-name-to-host mapping, timeout, and URL constraints.
Inspect the checked-in workflow and prove live probing is workflow_dispatch-only and dispatches fail when GITHUB_REF is not refs/heads/main.
Prove trusted exact main-event checkout, full branch-ref availability, exact Production-ref equality, and required auth plus connector enforcement.
Exercise exact auth and connector parity with an explicitly optional additional endpoint.
Exercise required endpoint deployed-SHA drift and untrusted identity fields while proving raw or malformed identity values are not persisted.
Reject loopback, private, link-local, documentation, multicast, invalid, and over-cardinality DNS results before TLS or HTTP execution.
Inspect bounded DNS and full-response HTTP timeout enforcement, exercise TLS failure, and verify secret redaction.
Emit a bounded secret-free component result without performing a live request in pull-request context.
assertions: The synthetic runtime report contract is mad4b.production-runtime-parity-evidence.v1.
The workflow has no push, schedule, pull_request_target, issue_comment, or deployment trigger.
Live probing runs only for workflow_dispatch; the contract job fails unless GITHUB_REF is refs/heads/main.
The workflow uses contents: read and checkout persist-credentials=false.
The live job checks out exact github.sha from a main-ref dispatch with full remote branch history and requires expected_sha to equal refs/remotes/origin/Production.
Only the fixed auth, connector, and dev endpoint names are accepted, each bound to its matching mad4b.com host on HTTPS port 443 and path /version without credentials, queries, or fragments.
DNS fails closed on loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation, invalid, or more than 16 returned addresses, and accepted public addresses are hashed before persistence.
The checked implementation applies bounded timeout enforcement to DNS, TLS, and the complete HTTP response body.
HTTP redirects are not followed, application/json is required, and response bodies are bounded before parsing.
The raw response body, unknown JSON fields, malformed identity values, and error details are never written to the artifact.
Required endpoints pass only when service equals http_generic_api_connector, deployed_commit_sha equals the exact requested SHA, and deployment branch equals Production.
The report declares secrets_included=false and all mutation/effect flags false.
Workflow enforcement requires auth and connector as required passed endpoints, first_failure=null, and tooling_sha equal to the exact trusted main event SHA.

steps: Dispatch the trusted-main workflow for the exact current Production SHA and approved host topology.
Upload and enforce the structured JSON and Markdown artifact before consulting diagnostic logs.
Attach the run identity and bounded outcome to issue 4948 without secrets.

phases.objective: Add bounded retry policy, certificate-expiry thresholds, multi-address parity, and artifact publication to the canonical issue evidence path without weakening first-failure reporting.
Run the exact verifier against a non-production deployment before future protected promotions.
Require a successful run-bound live parity artifact after every Production promotion before declaring deployment complete.
